column5: Do not introduce a medium the contract does not name
Every figure states its role
a contract's medium is reopened by that record and by nothing else. A host that cannot render the admitted notation is a case of *the medium could not carry it*.
Every figure drawn or kept meets `FIGURE-FORMAT.md`, and `art` owns source and rendering agreement.

The tests cover headings, first sentences, summaries including table summaries, and example labels, not only body text.
An untaught relationship or missing model is sent back as a `draft` correction run, never repaired in sentences.
Reword teaching text only; a defect in a normative sentence's wording or force goes back as a `draft` correction run rather than being repaired here.
